recognize_zh: 這其實是骨髓抹片（標題誤植為周邊血尾端說明）：可見成群的成熟漿細胞（偏心核、車輪狀染色質、藍色細胞質與核周淡染區），夾雜小淋巴球與漿細胞樣淋巴球，背景有淡黃褐色無結構的團塊狀沉積物，符合淋巴漿細胞淋巴瘤合併冷凝球蛋白沉積。
features: Cluster of mature plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, clock-face chromatin, perinuclear hof and deep blue cytoplasm
Admixed small lymphocytes with condensed chromatin and plasmacytoid lymphocytes
Occasional neutrophil and myeloid precursor; no blasts in this field
Background with pale tan/yellowish amorphous globular extracellular deposits and a bluish-staining ground
Cells trapped at edges of the deposits; no discrete blue globules as described in the title
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of mature plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin and basophilic cytoplasm, admixed with small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes, with occasional granulocytic cells. The background contains pale, tan-to-pale-blue amorphous globular extracellular deposits. The image depicts a marrow aspirate rather than the tail of a peripheral smear stated in the title, so the match is partial. In the context of lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma, the lymphoplasmacytic infiltrate with amorphous background deposits is suggestive of cryoglobulin precipitation; flow cytometry, MYD88 L265P testing and serum studies are needed for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Myeloma shows sheets of plasma cells, often immature, without the admixed small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes of LPL, and is MYD88 wild-type.

ddx.dx: Marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: MZL overlaps morphologically; MYD88 L265P and IgM paraprotein with marrow paratrabecular/interstitial pattern favor LPL.
Reactive plasma cells are polytypic and not accompanied by a clonal B-cell population or cryoglobulin deposits.
Fat droplets are clear, empty round spaces, whereas cryoglobulin deposits are homogeneous, lightly stained amorphous material.
